query_origin: Reconstructed from the recorded gold files and passage ranges because the baseline report did not preserve its full query strings.

settings.ranking_implementation: Python local cosine; Obsidian CLI exports only query vectors and block locators
settings.raw_only_filter: exclude index.md and filenames prefixed SYNTHESIS, DECISION-, EXPERIMENT-; generated source slices remain eligible and resolve through manifests

metrics_definition.source_rank: rank of first source-vector result whose path (or source-slice manifest origin) is the gold file
metrics_definition.passage_rank: rank of first block-vector result resolving to the gold file and the gold line interval
metrics_definition.passage_exact: block citation lines are fully contained in the recorded gold_lines interval
metrics_definition.passage_related: block resolves within the containing Markdown heading section or a recorded related_lines interval, but is not exact
metrics_definition.citation_target_correct_at_1: top passage resolves to the gold file and its mapped lines overlap gold_lines; citation_target_exact_at_1 separately requires full containment. Neither checks generated answer text or quotation wording
metrics_definition.ooc_refusal: retrieval abstention only: no source or passage result clears min_score; no answer-generation/refusal model is tested

comparison_caveats: The earlier 20-question report did not preserve its exact prompts; this set labels reconstructed queries and is not a strict prompt-for-prompt replication.
This run includes the current corpus and targeted source slices; compare all and raw_only within this result, not as an exact before/after score against reports with different corpus snapshots.
